title: #smallpoems leaping into expectation upon thread bare histories his consistencies unwound chasing hopes eternal mysteries unbound racing fates scissor
summary: #smallpoems leaping into expectation upon thread bare histories his consistencies unwound chasing hopes eternal mysteries unbound racing fates scissors through blizzards of hope all poetry meant to be set free so he sails seas of misery
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
leaping into expectation
upon thread bare
histories
his
consistencies unwound
chasing hopes eternal mysteries
unbound
racing fates
scissors
through blizzards of hope
all poetry
meant to be set free
so he sails
seas of misery
